lede: The most consequential meeting this week is Monday's joint HARC and P&Z session on amendments to the Town's Land Use Code and Design Guidelines — changes required to bring Telluride into compliance with the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code, with whatever they recommend heading straight to Town Council. Also worth watching: the Telluride Hospital District board takes up mill levy considerations on Thursday, and the Shandoka Lot redevelopment at 860 Black Bear Rd gets its first real P&Z work session. On the lighter side, the Sunset Concert Series, Market on the Plaza, and the Oak Street Park SummerSHOW Series kick off what's shaping up to be a full week in the valley.
